title: Mizzen record URL map
description: Every record id and the URL of its page. The file only ever gains fields: a field it has today keeps its meaning.

engine.description: The Mizzen version that wrote the file.

data.description: SHA-256 of the record ids and fields the map describes, so a reader can tell a stale file from a fresh one.

collections.description: Record ids by collection name. Each value is the page's absolute URL when the site sets url, and a path otherwise.
